c74object.name: el.sel~
c74object.digest: Sample-accurate signal value selector and click router
c74object.description:
el.sel~ is a sample-accurate signal selector and router that functions analogously to the Max control object select. On every sample tick, it evaluates the incoming audio signal against its list of target values. When an incoming sample matches a target value, a single-sample impulse (1.0) is emitted from the corresponding signal outlet; at all other times, the outlet outputs 0.0.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal): Input signal to evaluate against target match values.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Match trigger outputs (one outlet per target value argument). Emits a single-sample 1.0 click on the exact sample a match occurs, and 0.0 at all other times.

inlet.description: Audio signal evaluated on a sample-by-sample basis against the target match values.

outlet.description: Outputs a 1.0 click impulse when the input signal matches the first argument value.
Subsequent match outlets corresponding to remaining argument target values (up to 256 outlets).

objarg.name: match-values
objarg.description: Required. One or more numeric target values to test against incoming audio samples. Each value creates a corresponding signal outlet (up to 256 outlets).

method.name: signal
method.description: Continuous audio stream compared against target values on every sample tick.
